question:
The marks scored by 10 students are given below.

13, 20, 15, 13, 19, 12, 12, 11, 13, 10

The mode of the given data is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mode of a dataset is simply the value that appears most frequently.

By visually observing the given marks, the value 13 appears 3 times, which is the highest repetition.

All other values appear only 1 or 2 times.

**∴ The correct answer is 13 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks scored by 10 students: 13, 20, 15, 13, 19, 12, 12, 11, 13, 10

**Formula Used:**

Mode = Observation with the maximum frequency in the data set.
